items.text: Some of you may know about my health issues over the last few years. I had a bone marrow transplant in January of 2025 for a rare disease called VEXAS and Blood Cancer. Since then, I have been dealing with complications from that transplant.
For the last month I had been admitted to the NIH (National Institutes of Health) in Maryland for some pretty serious health issues. I just got home a few days ago.
I wanted to address this in case anyone thought that I just disappeared and stopped supporting the games. I will always do my best and support all of our games as long as I can.

With all this being said. I thought maybe we could put any bugs, issues, or suggestions for the game all in one place. This will make it easier for me to go through once I am able to start working on the game again. It can be in the comments section here, a new thread in the forum area, or anywhere else.
I really appreciate all of the support and patience through difficult times like these. You all mean everything to me.
-Wes

It has been a little while so I wanted to give a little update on things.

We just got back from Maryland to our home in Indiana a couple of weeks ago. I had successful bone marrow transplant done in January at the NIH (National Institutes of Health) in Maryland. I just got the call that the UAB1 test came back, and I no longer have VEXAS. This is the best news. It is still a long road to full recovery but the is such great news. I still have to wait until July when I go back for my follow up and have a bone marrow biopsy done to see if the Blood Cancer is gone but the doctors are very confident that it is gone as well. This journey has been a roller coaster of emotions. I am so thankful for my donor who has blessed me with a second chance at life. Even through these difficult times God has blessed us in so many ways. We are very thankful.

I was not able to work on or do any updates to either Morels game while I was out in Maryland. The project files that I had access to for the games would just constantly crash. I do not know if it was an issue with the laptop I was using or an issue with the project files.

I spent most of my time in Maryland just trying to recover from the transplant and then working on my solo game Bigfoot Life. We have also started to work on the next Morels game. Morels: Out of this World. I can't wait to share more information on this game. The goal was when I got back I was going to do an update for both Morels games based on a lot of the feedback I've seen posted in the Steam Hubs. I also released a demo of Bigfoot life and entered it in the Steam Next Fest. Well, this has ended up being a little too much all at once and I've actually started to get a little bit of GVHD (Graft Versus Host Disease). The doctors believe it could just be from stress of over doing it with the game stuff. They have suggested that I step back a little and give my body more time to heal from the transplant. I decided to pulled Bigfoot Life out of the Steam Fest as well.

I am still planning on doing the updates to the Morels games as well as give out more information on the new game. Right now though I've decided from feedback from my doctor's that it is best if I ease back into things and don't feel so rushed to do everything. Recovery from the transplant takes a long time and I have to prioritize my health. So, the updates and information on the new game are coming. They may just take a little longer than I originally was hoping.
-Wes

releases.displayName: Morels: The Hunt 2 - April 29th Patch Notes

items.text: Thank you to everyone who has played and supported the game. Also, thank you for all of the feedback and bug reports.
If you have enjoyed playing the game, maybe consider leaving a review. They are extremely helpful.
Missing mushrooms from your tent in the Mountain Forest map. - This should now be fixed and you should be able to see the morel mushrooms you've picked that day in your tent.
Controller bug when purchasing certain items like Bug Spray. - You should now be able to open your inventory again after purchasing items with the controller like Bug Spray.
Your Shoes in your inventory should no longer have an option to "Put On" if you are already wearing them.
We made the collision boxes a little larger around items in the shop so you don't have to get as close to the tables to open up the shop menu for that item.
More updates to come. Thank you again for all of your support!
-The Abrams Studios Team
Thank you again to everyone who has played and supported Morels 2. It means so much to us. We've been listening to your feedback and have a new build live with some updates and fixes.

We have added Night Vision back in as a camera mode option. It will be a free upgrade with the purchase of the upgraded headlamp. We have added a sign to the headlamp upgrade stand that lets you know about the Night Vision free camera mode update.
We have updated the insect collision so it does not collide and alter vehicles.
Disappearing hummingbird feeders - This should now be fixed.

Golf Cart Too Tired Corrupt Save Game - There was a bug that would sometimes corrupt your save game if you were on your golf cart when the "Too Tired" message came up at the end of the day. This should be fixed now.

Random Werewolf Mystery Animal - A bug was causing a werewolf to spawn in the Mountain Forest map instead of a normal wolf. This should be fixed now and you should not be able to see the Werewolf in this game anymore.
Animals and mushrooms underwater in the Mountain Forest Map. - This should hopefully be fixed now and you should not see many if any animals or mushrooms pinned underwater in this map.

Hare, this animal is dead bug - There was a bug that caused the hare to not play the dead animation when it would be attacked by a coyote or other predators. A message would say that the animal was dead but it clearly looked alive. This was due to it not playing the correct animations. This should be fixed now.
Other minor fixes like some floating foliage or meshes.
We will keep listening to your feedback and putting out updates. Thank you again for all the support.
-The Abrams Studios Team

releases.displayName: Morels: The Hunt 2 - April 21st Patch Notes

items.text: Thank you to everyone who has played and supported the game. We hope everyone has enjoyed playing it. It has been a great launch. We have such a great community. If you have enjoyed playing the game, maybe consider leaving a review. They are really helpful.
We have done a bunch of optimizations to the game that should hopefully fix the Fatal Error Crash that sometimes happens. If you are still experiencing this crash there are a few things you can try.
Make sure graphic drivers are up to date.
Try turning off Discord before launching the game.
Verify your game files. https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB
Try turning off the Squirrel Pong Loading Screen in Settings.
If you experience the crash when loading Birch Forest for the first time try loading the game again and see if it goes through without the crash the second time.
Start a new game in Exploration mode and go to another map like meadow lands first. Then go to Birch Forest and see if the game crashes. If it does not, try to load and play or main game again.

We are still working to figure out the cause of the crash. It does not appear to happen to that many people or that often but we really want to get it fixed completely. Until we know for sure it is fixed completely, the above options may fix it for you if you are experiencing it.

There were some other minor fixes as well that we have fixed in this build. Like some errors in text in for the Mystery Animals. We plan on putting out another update soon with some more fixes that have been listed in the bugs and suggestions forum. For this update we really wanted to focus on the Fatal Error Crash issue.
-The Abrams Studios Team

items.text: We just put out a small update to the game. We also wanted to share a great article that was written about the game on PC Gamer.

The issue with controller not working correctly sometimes when accessing the inventory after opening a shop menu item should be fixed. The issue was first reported here. https://steamcommunity.com/app/2686250/discussions/1/4365752248007314692/

2. Press "v" to add just the crosshairs.
